CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core10._can_review_stage_v1(p_request bigint, p_stage integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'core10'
AS $function$
DECLARE q core10.approval_requests%ROWTYPE;v_role text;
 actor uuid:=core10.actor_uid();
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO q FROM core10.approval_requests WHERE id=p_request;
 IF NOT FOUND OR actor IS NULL OR q.created_by=actor OR q.status<>'pending'
  OR q.expires_at_v1<=statement_timestamp()
  OR NOT core10.can_approval_action_v1(q.tenant_id,q.business_id,'approval.decide')
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT r.stages[p_stage] INTO v_role FROM core10.approval_routes_v1 r
 WHERE r.policy_id=q.policy_id_v1 AND r.tenant_id=q.tenant_id
  AND r.business_id=q.business_id AND p_stage BETWEEN 1 AND cardinality(r.stages);
 IF v_role IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF v_role='tenant_owner' THEN RETURN core10.can_tenant(q.tenant_id); END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core10.business_members m WHERE
   m.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND m.business_id=q.business_id
   AND m.user_id=actor AND m.role=v_role AND m.active
   AND (m.valid_until IS NULL OR m.valid_until>statement_timestamp()))
 THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 IF p_stage=1 AND v_role='business_owner' AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM core10.approval_delegations_v1 d
  JOIN core10.business_members recipient ON recipient.tenant_id=d.tenant_id
   AND recipient.business_id=d.business_id AND recipient.user_id=d.delegated_to
   AND recipient.role='manager' AND recipient.active
   AND (recipient.valid_until IS NULL OR recipient.valid_until>statement_timestamp())
  JOIN core10.business_members grantor ON grantor.tenant_id=d.tenant_id
   AND grantor.business_id=d.business_id AND grantor.user_id=d.granted_by
   AND grantor.role='business_owner' AND grantor.active
   AND (grantor.valid_until IS NULL OR grantor.valid_until>statement_timestamp())
  WHERE d.request_id=p_request AND d.stage_no=1 AND d.tenant_id=q.tenant_id
   AND d.business_id=q.business_id AND d.delegated_to=actor
   AND d.revoked_at IS NULL AND d.valid_until>statement_timestamp())
 THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 RETURN false;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core10.build01_context_v1()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'core10'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=core10.actor_uid(); response jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF actor IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUILD01_SIGNED_SESSION_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('actor_uid',actor,
 'real_auth_account_verified',to_regclass('auth.sessions') IS NOT NULL,
 'tenants',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'slug',t.slug) ORDER BY t.id)
  FROM core10.tenants t WHERE t.active AND (core10.can_tenant(t.id) OR EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM core10.businesses b WHERE b.tenant_id=t.id AND core10.can_see_business(t.id,b.id)))),'[]'::jsonb),
 'legal_entities',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',l.id,'tenant_id',l.tenant_id,'label',l.label) ORDER BY l.id)
  FROM core10.legal_entities l WHERE core10.can_tenant(l.tenant_id)),'[]'::jsonb),
 'templates',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code',t.code,'label',COALESCE(i.name_en,t.code),
   'source_status',t.source_status,'readiness',COALESCE(i.readiness,t.source_status),
   'draft_supported',true,'demo_allowed',t.demo_allowed,'enterprise_certified',t.enterprise_certified) ORDER BY t.code)
  FROM core10.templates t LEFT JOIN core10.industry_catalog_v2 i ON i.id=t.code
  WHERE i.id IS NOT NULL OR t.demo_allowed),'[]'::jsonb),
 'businesses',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'tenant_id',b.tenant_id,'slug',b.slug,
   'label',COALESCE(c.display_name,b.slug),'status',b.status,'can_manage',core10.can_manage(b.tenant_id,b.id),
   'role',CASE WHEN core10.can_tenant(b.tenant_id) THEN 'tenant_owner' ELSE COALESCE((
    SELECT m.role FROM core10.business_members m WHERE m.business_id=b.id AND m.user_id=actor AND m.active
     AND (m.valid_until IS NULL OR m.valid_until>statement_timestamp())),'site_staff') END) ORDER BY b.id)
  FROM core10.businesses b LEFT JOIN core10.business_configuration_v1 c ON c.business_id=b.id
  WHERE core10.can_see_business(b.tenant_id,b.id)),'[]'::jsonb),
 'sites',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'tenant_id',s.tenant_id,'business_id',s.business_id,
  'kind',s.kind,'label',s.label,'allowed_actions',to_jsonb(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM unnest(ARRAY['stock.read','stock.post']) a
   WHERE core10.can_site(s.tenant_id,s.business_id,s.id,a)))) ORDER BY s.id)
  FROM core10.sites s WHERE core10.can_manage(s.tenant_id,s.business_id)
   OR core10.can_site(s.tenant_id,s.business_id,s.id,'stock.read')),'[]'::jsonb),
 'production_certified',false,'data_mode','disposable-demo') INTO response;
 RETURN response;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core10.build01_workspace_v1(p_business bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'core10'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=core10.actor_uid(); tenant bigint; owner boolean; response jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT tenant_id INTO tenant FROM core10.businesses WHERE id=p_business;
 IF actor IS NULL OR tenant IS NULL OR NOT core10.can_see_business(tenant,p_business)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUILD01_BUSINESS_DENIED'; END IF;
 owner:=core10.can_manage(tenant,p_business);
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('actor_uid',actor,'business_id',p_business,'can_manage',owner,
 'business',(SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(core10.build01_context_v1()->'businesses') value WHERE value->>'id'=p_business::text),
 'sites',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'tenant_id',s.tenant_id,'business_id',s.business_id,'kind',s.kind,'label',s.label,
   'allowed_actions',to_jsonb(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM unnest(ARRAY['stock.read','stock.post']) a WHERE core10.can_site(tenant,p_business,s.id,a)))) ORDER BY s.id)
  FROM core10.sites s WHERE s.business_id=p_business AND (owner OR core10.can_site(tenant,p_business,s.id,'stock.read'))),'[]'::jsonb),
 'access',jsonb_build_object(
  'business_members',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.user_id) FROM core10.business_members m
   WHERE m.business_id=p_business AND (owner OR m.user_id=actor)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'site_grants',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY g.site_id,g.user_id) FROM core10.site_grants g
   WHERE g.business_id=p_business AND (owner OR g.user_id=actor)),'[]'::jsonb)),
 'audit',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.id DESC) FROM (
  SELECT * FROM core10.access_change_events_v1 WHERE business_id=p_business AND (owner OR subject_uid=actor) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100)e),'[]'::jsonb),
 'setup_runs',CASE WHEN owner THEN COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'business_id',r.business_id,'request_key',r.request_key,'created_by',r.created_by,'created_at',r.created_at) ORDER BY r.id)
  FROM core10.business_setup_runs_v1 r WHERE r.business_id=p_business),'[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
 'receipt_truth',jsonb_build_object('real_auth_account_verified',to_regclass('auth.sessions') IS NOT NULL,
  'production_certified',false,'money_movement',false)) INTO response;
 RETURN response;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core10.can_approval_action_v1(p_tenant bigint, p_business bigint, p_action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'core10'
AS $function$
 SELECT p_action=ANY(ARRAY['approval.submit','approval.decide','approval.delegate','approval.withdraw','approval.export','approval.exception'])
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core10.businesses b JOIN core10.tenants t ON t.id=b.tenant_id
  WHERE b.id=p_business AND b.tenant_id=p_tenant AND t.active
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core10.business_members d
    WHERE d.business_id=p_business AND d.tenant_id=p_tenant AND d.user_id=core10.actor_uid()
     AND d.active AND (d.valid_until IS NULL OR d.valid_until>statement_timestamp())
     AND (d.approval_valid_until IS NULL OR d.approval_valid_until>statement_timestamp())
     AND p_action=ANY(d.approval_denied_actions))
   AND (
     core10.can_tenant(p_tenant)
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core10.business_members m
       WHERE m.business_id=p_business AND m.tenant_id=p_tenant AND m.user_id=core10.actor_uid()
        AND m.active AND (m.valid_until IS NULL OR m.valid_until>statement_timestamp())
        AND (
          ((m.approval_valid_until IS NULL OR m.approval_valid_until>statement_timestamp()) AND p_action=ANY(m.approval_actions))
          OR (m.role='business_owner')
          OR (m.role='manager' AND p_action=ANY(ARRAY['approval.submit','approval.withdraw']))
        ))
   ))
$function$

AS $function$

 WHERE b.id=p_business AND b.tenant_id=p_tenant AND t.active AND
 (core10.can_tenant(p_tenant) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core10.business_members m
 WHERE m.business_id=p_business AND m.tenant_id=p_tenant AND m.user_id=core10.actor_uid()
 AND m.active AND (m.valid_until IS NULL OR m.valid_until>statement_timestamp()) AND m.role IN('business_owner','manager'))))

 LANGUAGE sql

AS $function$
 SELECT core10.can_business(p_tenant,p_business) OR EXISTS(

 AND core10.can_site(p_tenant,p_business,s.id,'stock.read'))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core10.can_site(p_tenant bigint, p_business bigint, p_site bigint, p_action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'core10'
AS $function$
 SELECT p_action=ANY(ARRAY['stock.read','stock.post']) AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM core10.sites s JOIN core10.tenants t ON t.id=s.tenant_id
 WHERE s.id=p_site AND s.tenant_id=p_tenant AND s.business_id=p_business AND t.active
 -- Explicit active denies precede inherited owner/manager rights. A denied read
 -- also blocks posting because canonical stock writes need that record context.
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core10.site_grants g WHERE g.site_id=p_site
  AND g.user_id=core10.actor_uid() AND g.active AND (g.valid_until IS NULL OR g.valid_until>statement_timestamp())
  AND (p_action=ANY(g.denied_actions) OR (p_action='stock.post' AND 'stock.read'=ANY(g.denied_actions))))
 AND (core10.can_business(p_tenant,p_business) OR EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM core10.site_grants g WHERE g.site_id=p_site AND g.tenant_id=p_tenant AND g.business_id=p_business
  AND g.user_id=core10.actor_uid() AND g.active AND (g.valid_until IS NULL OR g.valid_until>statement_timestamp())
  AND p_action=ANY(g.actions))))
$function$

 WHERE t.id=p_tenant AND t.active AND m.user_id=core10.actor_uid() AND m.active AND m.role='tenant_owner')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core10.my_approval_activity_v1(p_business bigint, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS TABLE(event_id bigint, business_id bigint, request_id bigint, action text, occurred_at timestamp with time zone, stage_no integer, approval_status text, audit_event_id bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'core10'
AS $function$
DECLARE tenant bigint;actor uuid:=core10.actor_uid();
BEGIN
 IF actor IS NULL OR p_business IS NULL OR p_limit IS NULL
  OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'approval_report_denied'; END IF;
 SELECT b.tenant_id INTO tenant FROM core10.businesses b WHERE b.id=p_business;
 IF tenant IS NULL OR NOT (
  core10.can_business(tenant,p_business)
  OR core10.can_tenant(tenant)
  OR core10.can_approval_action_v1(tenant,p_business,'approval.export')
  OR core10.can_approval_action_v1(tenant,p_business,'approval.decide'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'approval_report_denied'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 SELECT e.id,e.business_id,e.request_id,e.action,e.created_at,
        st.stage_no,q.status,a.id
 FROM core10.approval_events e
 JOIN core10.approval_requests q
   ON q.id=e.request_id AND q.tenant_id=e.tenant_id
   AND q.business_id=e.business_id
 JOIN core10.canonical_audit_events_v1 a
   ON a.source_domain='approval' AND a.source_ref=e.id::text
   AND a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.business_id=e.business_id
   AND a.action='approval.'||e.action
 LEFT JOIN core10.approval_stage_receipts_v1 st
   ON st.event_id=e.id AND st.request_id=e.request_id
 WHERE e.business_id=p_business AND e.tenant_id=tenant
  AND (
   core10.can_manage(q.tenant_id,q.business_id)
   OR (q.created_by=actor AND core10.can_business(q.tenant_id,q.business_id))
   OR (q.status='pending' AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM core10.approval_routes_v1 route
     WHERE route.policy_id=q.policy_id_v1
       AND core10._can_review_stage_v1(q.id,
        (SELECT count(*)::integer+1 FROM core10.approval_stage_receipts_v1 s
          WHERE s.request_id=q.id))
   ))
  )
 ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT p_limit;
END $function$

args: p_business bigint, p_limit integer
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core10.my_approval_status_v1(p_business bigint, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS TABLE(request_id bigint, business_id bigint, domain text, action_code text, source_key text, source_version bigint, policy_version integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, expires_at timestamp with time zone, stored_status text, display_status text, required_checks integer, completed_checks integer, can_review_now boolean, is_maker boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'core10'
AS $function$
DECLARE tenant bigint;actor uuid:=core10.actor_uid();
BEGIN
 IF actor IS NULL OR p_business IS NULL OR p_limit IS NULL
  OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'approval_report_denied'; END IF;
 SELECT b.tenant_id INTO tenant FROM core10.businesses b WHERE b.id=p_business;
 IF tenant IS NULL OR NOT (
  core10.can_business(tenant,p_business)
  OR core10.can_tenant(tenant)
  OR core10.can_approval_action_v1(tenant,p_business,'approval.decide'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'approval_report_denied'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 SELECT q.id,q.business_id,q.domain_v1,q.action_code_v1,
  q.source_key_v1,q.source_version_v1,q.policy_version_v1,
  q.created_at,q.expires_at_v1,q.status,
  CASE
   WHEN q.status='pending' AND q.expires_at_v1<=statement_timestamp() THEN 'expired'
   WHEN q.status='pending' AND route.policy_id IS NOT NULL
    THEN 'awaiting_stage_'||(rc.completed+1)::text
   ELSE q.status END AS display_status,
  COALESCE(cardinality(route.stages),1)::integer AS required_checks,
  rc.completed,
  (q.status='pending' AND q.expires_at_v1>statement_timestamp()
   AND route.policy_id IS NOT NULL
   AND rc.completed<cardinality(route.stages)
   AND core10._can_review_stage_v1(q.id,rc.completed+1)),
  q.created_by=actor
 FROM core10.approval_requests q
 LEFT JOIN core10.approval_routes_v1 route
  ON route.policy_id=q.policy_id_v1 AND route.tenant_id=q.tenant_id
    AND route.business_id=q.business_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS completed
  FROM core10.approval_stage_receipts_v1 s WHERE s.request_id=q.id
 ) rc
 WHERE q.tenant_id=tenant AND q.business_id=p_business AND q.policy_id_v1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
   core10.can_manage(q.tenant_id,q.business_id)
   OR (q.created_by=actor AND core10.can_business(q.tenant_id,q.business_id))
   OR (q.status='pending' AND route.policy_id IS NOT NULL
       AND rc.completed<cardinality(route.stages)
       AND core10._can_review_stage_v1(q.id,rc.completed+1))
  )
 ORDER BY q.created_at DESC,q.id DESC LIMIT p_limit;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core10.my_routed_review_tasks_v1(p_business bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(request_id bigint, business_id bigint, domain text, action_code text, source_key text, source_version bigint, policy_version integer, stage_no integer, stage_total integer, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'core10'
AS $function$
DECLARE tenant bigint;actor uuid:=core10.actor_uid();
BEGIN
 SELECT b.tenant_id INTO tenant FROM core10.businesses b WHERE b.id=p_business;
 IF actor IS NULL OR p_business IS NULL OR tenant IS NULL
  OR NOT core10.can_approval_action_v1(tenant,p_business,'approval.decide')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'reviewer_task_access_denied'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 SELECT q.id,q.business_id,q.domain_v1,q.action_code_v1,q.source_key_v1,
  q.source_version_v1,q.policy_version_v1,
  (SELECT count(*)::integer+1 FROM core10.approval_stage_receipts_v1 s
    WHERE s.request_id=q.id) AS current_stage,
  cardinality(rt.stages),q.expires_at_v1
 FROM core10.approval_requests q
 JOIN core10.approval_routes_v1 rt ON rt.policy_id=q.policy_id_v1
   AND rt.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND rt.business_id=q.business_id
 WHERE q.business_id=p_business AND q.tenant_id=tenant
  AND q.status='pending' AND q.expires_at_v1>statement_timestamp()
  AND q.created_by<>actor
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core10.approval_stage_receipts_v1 s
    WHERE s.request_id=q.id AND s.actor_id=actor)
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM core10.approval_stage_receipts_v1 s
    WHERE s.request_id=q.id)<cardinality(rt.stages)
  AND core10._can_review_stage_v1(q.id,
    (SELECT count(*)::integer+1 FROM core10.approval_stage_receipts_v1 s WHERE s.request_id=q.id))
 ORDER BY q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 100;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core10.verify_approval_binding_v1(p_request bigint, p_business bigint, p_domain text, p_action text, p_source_key text, p_source_version bigint, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'core10', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_req core10.approval_requests%ROWTYPE;
  v_event bigint;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_req FROM core10.approval_requests WHERE id = p_request;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_req.policy_id_v1 IS NULL OR v_req.status <> 'approved'
    OR v_req.expires_at_v1 <= clock_timestamp()
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'approval_not_effective'; END IF;

  IF p_payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload) <> 'object'
    OR v_req.business_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_business
    OR v_req.domain_v1 IS DISTINCT FROM p_domain
    OR v_req.action_code_v1 IS DISTINCT FROM p_action
    OR v_req.source_key_v1 IS DISTINCT FROM p_source_key
    OR v_req.source_version_v1 IS DISTINCT FROM p_source_version
    OR v_req.payload_sha256_v1 IS DISTINCT FROM
       encode(sha256(convert_to(p_payload::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'approval_stale_or_payload_changed'; END IF;

  SELECT id INTO v_event FROM core10.approval_events
    WHERE request_id = p_request AND action = 'approve';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'approval_receipt_missing'; END IF;
  RETURN v_event;
END $function$
